record.question:
With reference to the traditional Mizo ceremony Kawngpui Siam, consider the following statements:
     1. It was an annual sacrifice performed specifically to plead for rain during periods of long drought.
     2. The Sadawt (priest) was accompanied by up to seven individuals, all of whom must have the
          word malsawm in their names.
     3. If the animal sacrificed was a pig, its feet were hung up on the leaves of a chestnut tree (thingsia).
     4. On the morning after the ceremony, young men examined the sprinkled ash on the path; finding
          footprints of wild animals was considered a bad omen for upcoming hunts.
    Which of the statements given above is/are CORRECT?
